system.description:
You unleash an aggressive assault of profane insults towards a creature in range, if the target can hear you. But these words are poisoned with illusory triggers that cause hallucinations. The target creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Critical Success: The target takes no damage and suffers no additional effects.

Success: The target takes half of 4d6 psychic damage as they resist some of this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and gains 1 rank of Disoriented.

Critical Failure: Same effects as a failure, but the target suffers disadvantage on all attacks it makes until the end of its next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Disoriented inflicted by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Disoriented inflicted by +1.
